title: One Assistant, Many Memories: Benchmarking Real-World Group Assistance When Recall Is Not Enough
summary: GroupAssistBench evaluates recall and useful assistance using 80,299 messages from 50 real group chats. In the reported comparisons, the strongest memory system approached full-context performance on recall but lagged on applying memories, especially for distributed or conflicting information; two memory-use additions improved benchmark results.
ai_technology: Group-assistance benchmark using real group-chat histories
organization: Tencent Yuanbao Team; King's College London; Qilu University of Technology; Renmin University of China; Shandong University

evidence.ai_role: The study evaluates frontier models, retrieval methods and memory systems on real group-chat histories, scoring both factual recall and the use of memories in open-ended requests.
